meta_description: Gardeningreina offers complete garden maintenance, design, and landscaping across Southampton. Reliable local gardener. Call today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and design that turns your outdoor space into somewhere you actually want to spend time.
services_subhead: From regular maintenance to full garden redesigns, we handle every aspect of garden care with attention to detail and genuine local knowledge.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Lawn Care
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly cuts, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal tidying. We keep your garden looking immaculate year-round and adjust schedules to suit your needs.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs that work with your space, budget, and vision. Includes paving, decking, planting schemes, and structural work to create gardens that feel personal.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Quality patio laying and timber decking builds that enhance your outdoor living. Built to last with proper drainage and solid foundations.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Pruning
services.desc: Expert pruning keeps hedges, shrubs, and trees healthy and shaped. We tidy overgrown borders and reduce growth safely, respecting mature plants.

services.title: Turfing & Seeding
services.desc: New lawns laid or existing grass revived through professional seeding and care. Results in thick, healthy turf that's ready to use within weeks.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Waste Removal
services.desc: Full garden overhauls, from removing debris and old structures to prepping ground for new planting. All waste responsibly disposed of or recycled.

about_pullquote: I garden the way I'd want my own garden treated—with care, attention, and no shortcuts.
about_para_1: Gardeningreina was founded on a simple idea: Southampton deserves gardens that reflect what their owners actually want. With over 12 years' experience in residential and commercial garden work, I've learned that every garden tells a different story. Whether you need weekly maintenance to keep up with growth, a complete redesign to unlock potential, or one-off clearance work, I treat each project as if it's my own space.
about_para_2: My clients return because I listen first, deliver reliably, and price fairly—no inflated quotes or surprise bills. I'm based locally in Southampton, I turn up on time, and I take genuine pride in seeing a garden go from neglected to somewhere people actually want to relax. That reputation matters more to me than quick cash jobs.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Reina transformed our overgrown back garden into something we actually use now. She listened to what we wanted, came up with clever ideas we hadn't thought of, and the whole job was finished on time. Couldn't ask for better. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using Gardeningreina for maintenance every fortnight for two years. She's reliable, hardworking, and genuinely cares about the garden. The quality hasn't slipped once. Best decision we made was getting someone local to handle it properly.
reviews.author: Fiona G.

reviews.text: Cleared our entire garden and laid a new patio. Reina sorted it all—got quotes, managed the work, and cleared the debris. Fair price and no faffing about. Really pleased with the end result. Would definitely book her again.
reviews.author: David K.
